'''0.27c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that adjusted equipment damage and added the ability to choose an equipment profile before a match starts.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Removed the dependency of the breakdown of weapons from the number of shots
* Breaking items now depends on the time of the game and on the equipment profile in which they are located
* Added the ability to choose the equipment profile before the match
* Added message about critical bleeding
* Added message about the player who killed you in the equipment profile selection screen

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed synchronization errors when switching equipment profile
* Fixed incorrect display of number of slots for additional items in the equipment profile selection screen
* Fixed medals receiving "steel" and "retribution"
* Fixed collision bugs that caused falling “under the level”
* Fixed bugs in [[Team Deathmatch]] due to which players appeared “under the level”
* Fixed lighting of particles system (incorrectly light dark rooms)
